```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)
library(brms)

freqColors = c("#247C7F","#F18F01","#22223B")
alignmentColors = c("#09AE0C","#571F4E")
```


```{r}
# path to your folder
data_dir <- "osfstorage-archive"

# get all CSV file paths
files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# read and combine all participant data
allData <- map_dfr(files, function(file) {
  # extract filename without extension
  filename <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
  
  # split into userID and ProlificID (e.g., "0a47vby8mu_67ea38f2f2477e3cbdb8202a")
  parts <- strsplit(filename, "_")[[1]]
  userID <- parts[1]
  ProlificID <- parts[2]
  
  # read the CSV and add both IDs
  read_csv(file,
           show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(userID = userID,
           ProlificID = ProlificID)
})

prolificData <- read_csv("prolificData.csv") %>% 
  rename("ProlificID" = 'Participant id')

lookupTable <- allData %>% 
  filter(!is.na(bias)) %>% 
  select(ProlificID,userID,term,topic,bias,exposure,valence) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  left_join(prolificData, by='ProlificID') %>% 
  select(c(userID,term,topic,bias,exposure,valence,'U.s. political affiliation',Age,Sex)) %>% 
  rename('politicalParty' = 'U.s. political affiliation') %>% 
  mutate(
    alignment = case_when(
      politicalParty == "Democrat" & bias == "left" ~ "aligned",
      politicalParty == "Republican" & bias == "right" ~ "aligned",
      TRUE ~ 'disaligned'
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    termLength = str_length(term)
  )

workerCount <- allData %>% 
  select(userID) %>% 
  unique()

poliCount <- lookupTable %>% 
  select(userID,politicalParty) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  group_by(politicalParty) %>% 
  summarize(
    count = n()
  )
  
  

lexicalDecision <- allData %>% 
  filter(category == "LexicalDecision") %>% 
  mutate(
    isCorrectCorrected = case_when(
      statusCheck == "correct" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(-c("term","exposure","valence","bias")) %>% 
  rename("term" = stimulus)

lexicalDecisionCoded <- lexicalDecision %>%
  left_join(lookupTable, by = c("userID", "term"))

lexicalDecisionFiltered <- lexicalDecisionCoded %>%
  filter(rt >= 300, rt <= 3000) %>%
  group_by(userID) %>%
  mutate(
    rt_z = (rt - mean(rt, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(rt, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(rt_z > -3, rt_z < 3) %>%
  filter(criticality == "critical") %>% 
  filter(politicalParty != "CONSENT_REVOKED")
  
  
  # ungroup() %>% 
  # mutate(taggedCorrect = ifelse(criticality == 'rejected' & !is.na(topic.y),FALSE,TRUE)) %>% 
  # filter(taggedCorrect == TRUE)

```

# Lexical Decision Time

position = position_dodge(0.9)

```{r}
lexicalDecisionFiltered %>% 
  mutate(
    exposure = case_when(
      status == 'not seen' ~ 'filler',
      TRUE ~ paste(exposure)
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(exposure != 'NA') %>%
  group_by(exposure) %>% 
  summarise(
    meanRt = mean(rt, na.rm = TRUE),
    seRt = sd(rt, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(exposure, levels=c("low","high","filler")), y = meanRt, color = exposure)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = meanRt - seRt, ymax = meanRt + seRt), width = 0.2) +
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_color_manual(values=freqColors) +
  labs(
    x="Term Exposure",
    y="Mean Reaction Time (ms)"
  ) + 
  theme(legend.position = 'none')
```


```{r}
lexicalDecisionFiltered %>% 
  mutate(topic.y=case_when(
    topic.y == "martialArts" ~ "martial arts",
    TRUE ~ paste(topic.y)
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    exposure = case_when(
      criticality == 'rejected' ~ 'filler',
      TRUE ~ paste(exposure)
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(exposure != 'NA') %>% 
  filter(exposure != 'filler') %>% 
  group_by(exposure,topic.y) %>% 
  summarise(
    meanRt = mean(rt, na.rm = TRUE),
    seRt = sd(rt, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n=n()
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(exposure, levels=c("low","high","filler")), y = meanRt, color = exposure)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = meanRt - seRt, ymax = meanRt + seRt), width = 0.2) +
  theme_bw() + 
  facet_wrap(~topic.y) +
  scale_color_manual(values=freqColors) + 
  labs(
    x="Term Exposure",
    y="Mean Reaction Time (ms)"
  ) + 
  theme(legend.position = 'none')
  # labs(y = "Mean RT (ms)", x = "Exposure", color = "Exposure")
```


```{r}
lexicalDecisionFiltered %>% 
     filter(is.na(exposure) & !is.na(topic.y))
```

```{r}
rtModel <- brm(
  rt ~ exposure * alignment + valence + (1 | userID) + (1 | term),
  data = lexicalDecisionFiltered,
  family = lognormal(),
  cores = 4, chains = 4, iter = 4000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)


summary(rtModel)
```


```{r}
library(gt)
library(broom.mixed)

rt_table <- tidy(rtModel, effects = "fixed") %>%
  select(term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high) %>%
  rename(
    Term = term,
    Estimate = estimate,
    `SE` = std.error,
    `95% CI (Lower)` = conf.low,
    `95% CI (Upper)` = conf.high
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))

rt_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Reaction Time Model (Lognormal)",
    subtitle = "Predictors of log-transformed reaction times"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(Estimate, SE, `95% CI (Lower)`, `95% CI (Upper)`),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Term = "Predictor",
    Estimate = "β",
    SE = "SE",
    `95% CI (Lower)` = "CI Low",
    `95% CI (Upper)` = "CI High"
  )

gtsave(rt_table %>% gt(), "rtModel_table.html")


```


```{r}
ce <- conditional_effects(rtModel, effects = "exposure:alignment")

p <- plot(ce, points = FALSE)[[1]] + 
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = alignmentColors) + 
  labs(
    x="Term Exposure",
    y="Predicted Reaction Time (ms)"
  ) 

p
```

## Lexical Decision Acc

```{r}
lexicalDecisionFiltered %>% 
  mutate(
    exposure = case_when(
      status == 'not seen' ~ 'filler',
      TRUE ~ paste(exposure)
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(exposure != 'NA') %>%
  group_by(exposure) %>% 
  summarise(
    meanAcc = mean(isCorrectCorrected, na.rm = TRUE),
    seAcc = sd(isCorrectCorrected, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(exposure, levels=c("low","high","filler")), y = meanAcc, color = exposure)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = meanAcc - seAcc, ymax = meanAcc + seAcc), width = 0.2) +
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_color_manual(values=freqColors) +
  labs(
    x="Term Exposure",
    y="Mean Decision Accuracy"
  ) + 
  theme(legend.position = 'none')
```


```{r}
accModel_brms <- brm(
  isCorrectCorrected ~ exposure * alignment + valence + (1 | userID) + (1 | term),
  data = lexicalDecisionFiltered,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  cores = 4, chains = 4, iter = 4000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)

summary(accModel_brms)
```
